case.title: All 8 answers equal to the middle value 3 fires

submissions.open_text: Water pressure drops every evening so we fill jerrycans in the morning
The kiosk attendant often closes early on Sundays

case.why: The rule is 'all 8 identical', whatever the value. An implementation that only looks for the extremes (all 1s or all 5s) misses straight-lining on the neutral midpoint, which is the most common way a lazy interviewer fills a grid. The other submission is varied, so the check is clearly per submission. Quiet checks: duration 1500 s is at least 720 s. Only one other submission falls on the same day, and same_spot needs 2. The two texts share no content words. There is no voice note. Both times are daytime. One contributor uses the device. There are only 2 submissions, so no burst. Both points are inside Kondele.
